opinionLines.text: {**11 NY3d at 850} OPINION OF THE COURT

Order affirmed. Defendant's argument that the evidence presented at trial was insufficient to support his conviction for{**11 NY3d at 851} depraved indifference murder is unpreserved for this Court's review (*see People v Hawkins*, 11 NY3d 484 [2008] [decided today]).
Concur: Chief Judge Kaye and Judges Ciparick, Graffeo, Read, Smith, Pigott and Jones.
